info.name: Fluxx Agent API
info.description:
Postman collection for the Fluxx observability agent's HTTP API.

All responses use the `StandardResponse` envelope: `{transactionUrn, status, responseMessage, responseKey, errors, timestamp, metadata, data, referenceUrn}`.

**Auth:** Set the `apiKey` collection variable. The `X-API-Key` header is only required when the agent is started with `FLUXX_API_KEY` set in its environment; otherwise leave it blank.

**Base URL:** defaults to `http://localhost:7007`. Override the `baseUrl` variable to point at a different deployment.

**Streams:** `/v1/stream` and `/v1/logs/stream` are WebSocket endpoints — Postman can open them via the WebSocket request type; this collection includes them as GET+Upgrade for reference.

**Generated:** 2026-04-23
